capabilities: Pin the active note as an always-on-top, movable overlay
Track per-task time with a stopwatch written back to Markdown
Add subtasks and set emoji statuses from the panel
Run optional focus sessions with a task queue and progress goal
Hide overlay content for privacy and adjust transparency or text size
disambiguation: Not a vault-wide task manager; it shows and edits the tasks of one pinned note in a floating window.
extras: Desktop only; always-on-top uses undocumented Electron APIs and degrades to a normal window if they break. The presentation screenshots come from a browser fixture, not a real vault. The repository also contains SimpleFocus, a standalone macOS menu-bar app without Obsidian.
motivation: The author built it so the current task stays above every window while working, and so time data is stored as plain text in the vault instead of locked inside another app.
problem: A task list gets covered by other windows, and time tracking usually lives in a separate app instead of inside the note.

relations.evidence: The @electron/remote runtime resolver is adapted from obsidian-synaptic-hatch (MIT).
A native macOS menu bar app with the same idea - a floating task panel above all windows

summary: Floating always-on-top task panel for the active note, with per-task stopwatch, emoji status, and optional focus sessions.
